title: Weavemoss
summary: Alchemy ingredient for Elixir of Arcane Cultivation.

fields.Crafting: Extract 3 Weavemoss into Vitriol of Weavemoss. Combine with any Sublimate to obtain Elixir of Arcane Cultivation. It grants a level 1 spell slot until Long Rest and replaces previous elixirs.
fields.Acquisition: Random loot and merchant stock, including Derryth Bonecloak.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
